reviews.review:
It is a decent game. Not a "great" game, not that much content there and some clear design errors, that are made in attempt to become "unique", especially regarding "meta" progression, but something like average PS2 mecha game. Only with no famous IP, less content, but much sleaker control. I wish Encounters in Space had it.

And since it is almost impossible to find anyone to play with, I judge the game as solely single-player experience.

Allied AI also suprisingl competent. Not at the level of Leagues of Legend hardest ai, it can't use "gates" to summon minions, it's a bit too agressive, but it's actually pretty good at pushing. On first two difficulties AI will easily push the lines with basically zero gathered "skills", and minimal mid-mission upgrades.

Game have kinda a bad rep, but most of the problems that are mentioned in other reviews actually has been adressed. For example, you can actually boost dodge, and I not sure if it was the same before, but there is not many skills that giving you temporal vulnerability. One suit have a skill that does it, and ultimates of, I think 3 suits (not counting variations) have it during "cutscene" (but I was killed during use of ultimates, after the cutscene ends several times.)

If only there was more than single map. I mean, it's a bit randomized every run but it always still the same map with too much red on the screen (barriers are red, towers are red, enemies are red, skybox is redish too), you will quickly feed up of it.

So, it's pretty much [b]a game that is fun for several evenings[/b], and not many will continue to play after but it also pretty cheap. So, if in doubt, just buy it.

And keep in mind that the ingame currency is reset every run, so "hire" an AI's (CPU's) to fill the slots, don't turn the game into solo slog, Don't repeat the mistake of the other reviewers "miser's instinct", ingrained by playing mobile games.
